wikipedia_en-simple_all_nopic.zim.name: Wikipedia (Simple English, text-only)
wikipedia_en-simple_all_nopic.zim.description: Full Simple English Wikipedia, no images. The best starting point — plain-language articles on almost everything, at a size that downloads and searches fast.

wikipedia_en-simple_all_maxi.zim.name: Wikipedia (Simple English, with images)
wikipedia_en-simple_all_maxi.zim.description: Same Simple English Wikipedia as above, but with every article's images included.

wikipedia_en_all_mini.zim.name: Wikipedia (English, condensed)
wikipedia_en_all_mini.zim.description: Every English Wikipedia article, condensed to its lead section — full breadth of topics without the full-size download.

wikipedia_en_all_nopic.zim.name: Wikipedia (English, full text)
wikipedia_en_all_nopic.zim.description: The complete English Wikipedia, full article text, no images. The real thing — plan for a large drive and a patient first download.

wikipedia_en_all_maxi.zim.name: Wikipedia (English, full text + images)
wikipedia_en_all_maxi.zim.description: The complete English Wikipedia with every article's images included — the largest option here by a wide margin. Make sure you actually have 130+ GB free before starting.

wikipedia_en_history_nopic.zim.name: History by Wikipedia (text-only)
wikipedia_en_history_nopic.zim.description: A curated slice of Wikipedia's history articles — world history broadly, so UK and US history are both well covered, just not split into their own archives (kiwix doesn't publish country-specific history wikis).

wikipedia_en_history_maxi.zim.name: History by Wikipedia (with images)
wikipedia_en_history_maxi.zim.description: Same history-article selection as above, with images included.

wikem_en_all_nopic.zim.name: WikEM — Emergency Medicine (text-only)
wikem_en_all_nopic.zim.description: A crowd-sourced emergency medicine reference — symptoms, treatment protocols, drug dosing. One of the highest-value small downloads for offline medical reference.

wikem_en_all_maxi.zim.name: WikEM — Emergency Medicine (with images)
wikem_en_all_maxi.zim.description: Same WikEM reference as above, with clinical photos and diagrams included — barely larger than the text-only version.

ifixit_en_all.zim.name: iFixit — Repair Guides
ifixit_en_all.zim.description: Step-by-step repair guides with photos for electronics, appliances, vehicles, and more — useful when replacement parts and internet access aren't both available. Already includes images (no text-only version exists).

diy.stackexchange.com_en_all.zim.name: Home Improvement Stack Exchange
diy.stackexchange.com_en_all.zim.description: How-to Q&A for home repair, renovation, and DIY projects — real questions and vetted answers, the closest thing here to WikiHow (which kiwix no longer distributes).

survivorlibrary.com_en_all.zim.name: Survivor Library — Pre-1970s Trade & Practical Skills (⚠ 252 GB)
survivorlibrary.com_en_all.zim.description: A huge scanned-book archive of pre-industrial and early-industrial trade knowledge — blacksmithing, farming, construction, mechanics, textiles, and more. Opt-in only: this is by far the largest thing in the catalog, so make sure you actually have 260+ GB free and a stable connection before starting.

appropedia_en_all_maxi.zim.name: Appropedia — Sustainability & Off-Grid Living
appropedia_en_all_maxi.zim.description: Appropriate-technology and sustainable-living wiki: water, energy, building, and food-growing techniques for low-resource or off-grid settings. Already includes images (no text-only version exists).

energypedia_en_all_nopic.zim.name: Energypedia — Off-Grid Energy (text-only)
energypedia_en_all_nopic.zim.description: Renewable and off-grid energy systems — solar, biogas, micro-hydro, mini-grids — aimed at practical, low-resource deployment.

energypedia_en_all_maxi.zim.name: Energypedia — Off-Grid Energy (with images)
energypedia_en_all_maxi.zim.description: Same Energypedia reference as above, with diagrams and photos included.

wikivoyage_en_all_nopic.zim.name: Wikivoyage — Travel Guide (text-only)
wikivoyage_en_all_nopic.zim.description: Worldwide travel guide — regions, routes, border crossings, and practical on-the-ground advice, text-only.

wikivoyage_en_all_maxi.zim.name: Wikivoyage — Travel Guide (with images)
wikivoyage_en_all_maxi.zim.description: Same Wikivoyage guide as above, with maps and photos included.

wiktionary_en_all_nopic.zim.name: Wiktionary — English Dictionary
wiktionary_en_all_nopic.zim.description: The complete English-language Wiktionary — definitions, etymology, and translations across thousands of languages. Dictionary content, so there's no meaningful image-included version.

outdoors.stackexchange.com_en_all.zim.name: Outdoors Stack Exchange
outdoors.stackexchange.com_en_all.zim.description: Q&A for backpacking, hiking, camping, and outdoor gear — real questions and vetted answers from an experienced community.
